title: Follow-up thresholds
description: Days since an Applied row's Applied Date at which it needs attention. One source of truth for Hermes followup_monitor.py (reads it at run time) and the browser's daily-brief.js / today-data.js (pinned equal by tests/hermes-followup-thresholds.test.mjs).

waitingReplyMinDays.description: From this many days, no reply means a follow-up is suggested (browser: waiting on a reply).

staleAppliedDays.description: From this many days the application is stale and the follow-up is overdue.

likelyClosedDays.description: From this many days the role is likely closed; Hermes suggests marking it Passed.
